en.hubeali:
From him, from Al Washa, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Muhammad Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> was asked, ‘What equates to freeing a neck?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Feeding a Muslim man’.
en.sarwar: 16. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from al-Washsha’ from Ali ibn abu Hamza from abu Basir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) asked, ‘How much is the value of setting free a slave?’ The Imam said, ‘It is equal to feeding a Muslim man to his satisfaction.’”
